sanskrit_verse:
वसेत स नरके घोरे दिनानि पशुरोमभिः /
सम्मितानि दुराचारो यो हन्त्यविधिना पशून् //
transliteration: vaseta sa narake ghore dināni paśu-romabhiḥ / sammitāni durācāro yo hanty avidhinā paśūn //
sph_interpretive_translation: He who kills animals without ritual injunction resides in a fearsome hell for as many days as there are hairs on the body of the slain animal.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The act of killing animals is regulated exclusively by Vedic ordinance; unauthorized action incurs karmic consequence.
Causation: The unordained destruction of life generates precise experiential correspondence through subtle law.
Capacity-based responsibility: One who acts without adherence to dharma bears full capacity-derived liability.
Restoration logic: Consciousness correction occurs through experiential mirroring until alignment with lawful intent is restored.
Consciousness alignment: Misaligned action necessitates immersive recalibration within causal substrata.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A kills animal B WITHOUT Vedic procedure THEN assign A to experience suffering equivalent to B's sensory field duration.
IF act violates dharmic protocol THEN generate experiential mirroring proportional to violated entity’s biological complexity.
IF consciousness misalignment detected THEN initiate causal feedback loop via immersive restorative sequence.
IF agent completes assigned mirroring THEN release from distortion and restore integrity pathway access.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that intentional harm to sentient beings without scriptural authorization invokes automatic karmic liability enforceable at the level of consciousness infrastructure. No external punishment is required; the law operates independently through prarabdha mechanics.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms that unauthorized violence disrupts cosmic order. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation of consequence mirroring the violated being's sensory continuum. Responsibility aligns precisely with capacity to know dharma. Retribution does not exist—only experiential completion restores balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate causal immersion corresponding to sensory field of harmed entity
Assign experiential mirroring equal to violated being’s physiological complexity
Monitor consciousness recalibration through karmic resonance tracking
Upon completion, activate liberation pathway to prevent recurrence
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this law executes autonomously through consciousness mechanics. There is no punishment—only precise restoration. Reality responds to misalignment with exacting clarity. Dharma is restored. Consciousness prevails.
